_note: Best choices compiled from gamepressure.com, game-checklists.com and allthings.how. basis=stated means a source says it; basis=judgement is my inference from the outcomes the source describes. Edit freely.

decisions.name: Inn at the Crossroads: the Baron's men
decisions.situation: How you treat the Baron's men in the inn decides how you reach the Baron at Crow's Perch.

options.label: Stay friendly in the timed conversation
options.result: The guards on the bridge don't react. You get permission to see the Baron.

options.label: Kill the bandits in the inn
options.result: The guards run away. You fight the Baron's henchmen, then pay a peasant 15 crowns to learn about an underwater tunnel into the castle.

best_moral.why: Nobody has to die.

best_outcome.why: It is the easy way in: no fight and no 15 crowns to pay.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Bloody Baron

decisions.name: Family Matters: the Baron's men at the Pellar's hut
decisions.situation: A group of the Baron's men is trying to get into the Pellar's house. You can react three ways.

options.label: Attack them
options.result: A fight against level 6 men. The crossbowmen can drop rare bolt types.

options.label: Ask why they are there and offer to heal their friend
options.result: They leave the Pellar alone in exchange.

options.label: Use Axii during the conversation
options.result: Needs a developed Axii sign. They leave and you get 40 experience points.

best_rewards.why: 40 experience points with no fight.

best_moral.why: Solves it without anyone being hurt.

decisions.note: Attacking is the only way to loot the rare bolts.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Family Matters

decisions.name: Family Matters: the burning barn
decisions.situation: On the way back to the castle a barn is on fire and you are asked to save the stable boy Oswin. It is a decision with a time limit.

options.label: Help save Oswin
options.result: You run through the barn and open the exit door to save Oswin and the horses. Later Oswin may thank you with 20 crowns.

options.label: Go straight to the Baron
options.result: Skips the rescue.

best_rewards.why: He gives you 20 crowns afterwards.

best_moral.why: A boy and the horses are saved.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Family Matters

decisions.name: Family Matters: the botchling
decisions.situation: After the fist fight the Baron takes you to where he buried his newborn. Save your game first.

options.label: Attack the botchling to kill it
options.result: It turns into a much larger beast and you fight it as a mini-boss. Afterwards you take Botchling Blood and help the Pellar perform a ritual.

options.label: Try to transform it into a lubberkin
options.result: The Baron carries it to the courtyard while wraiths attack; you calm it with Axii. You then follow the lubberkin to the fisherman's cabin.

best_moral.why: It saves the spirit instead of killing it.

decisions.note: The walkthrough says both options end at the fisherman's cabin and continue the same way, while the main-quest list calls this an important choice with great impact on the follow-up. The sources I could read do not say what the lasting difference is.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Family Matters

decisions.name: Tamara in Oxenfurt
decisions.situation: The Baron asks you to meet his daughter Tamara in Oxenfurt.

options.label: Agree with no conditions
options.result: You receive an additional 50 crowns.

options.label: Agree, but with conditions
options.result: No bonus.

best_rewards.why: An extra 50 crowns.

decisions.note: Guides disagree on whether skipping Tamara matters: one page says a family reunion happens anyway, another warns you can lose the chance to continue the Baron's storyline if you report Anna without looking for his daughter. Meet Tamara to be safe.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Family Matters; gamepressure.com: Return to the Crookback Bog

decisions.name: Wandering in the Dark: Keira's affection
decisions.situation: After closing the rifts the game gives you a time-limited dialogue choice.

options.label: Pick the first option
options.result: You fight for Keira's affection.

options.label: Pick another option
options.result: You don't.

decisions.note: The source says this is not a very important decision.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Wandering in the Dark

decisions.name: The spirit in the tree (Whispering Hillock)
decisions.situation: In The Whispering Hillock you decide the fate of the ghost in the tree. It sets how Return to the Crookback Bog goes and how the Baron's story ends. It is irreversible.

options.label: Kill the spirit (Option A, shorter)
options.result: Anna is left incurably sick in her mind and the Baron takes her home to a healer. The people of Downwarren are safe. The orphans die (gamepressure.com calls their fate unknown, but a player confirms killing the tree kills them). The military rules Velen.

options.label: Free the spirit (Option B, longer)
options.result: After the fiend fight Anna is a water hag. To save her find Johny, then the hidden basement altar, and pick the doll with the violet flower (the wrong doll and she burns). She returns to human form and dies at once; the Baron hangs himself; the freed spirit kills the people of Downwarren. The spirit says the children will be freed. The military rules Velen.

best_moral.why: Anna, the Baron and the people of Downwarren survive. It costs the orphans' lives, whereas freeing the spirit saves the children but costs Anna, the Baron and the villagers.

decisions.note: Both endings are grim and the sources call the Baron's fate similar either way. Killing the spirit is the player's pick for morals, even though the orphans die. To play Option B you must not start The Whispering Hillock until you have found the swamp village. Read the Return to the Crookback Bog walkthrough before starting Ladies of the Wood.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Return to the Crookback Bog; gamepressure.com: Major supporting characters; gamepressure.com: Family Matters; player report (orphans, and which choice is better)

decisions.name: Ciri's ending: the five decisions
decisions.situation: Ciri's fate comes from five dialogue/action choices in Blood on the Battlefield, Final Preparations and The Child of the Elder Blood, not from one big moment. The next five entries list each one.

options.label: Ciri dies
options.result: Make 3 of the 5 negative choices.

options.label: Ciri becomes a witcher
options.result: Mandatory: in Blood on the Battlefield do not go to the emperor with Ciri (go to Velen). Plus 2 more positive choices.

options.label: Ciri becomes empress
options.result: 3 of the 5 positive choices (including refusing the emperor's reward), plus the side quests An Eye for an Eye, A Deadly Plot and Redania's Most Wanted, telling Dijkstra about Ciri in Blindingly Obvious, and allying with Vernon Roche in Reason of State so Nilfgaard wins the war.

best_outcome.pick: Either the witcher or the empress ending
best_outcome.why: Both keep Ciri alive. Only the negative choices lead to her death.

decisions.note: Guides differ on the exact thresholds; this follows gamepressure.com. Do the positive answers below and Ciri lives.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Ciri's Fate

decisions.name: Blood on the Battlefield: Ciri is unhappy
decisions.situation: When Ciri is upset, the way you answer counts as one of her five decisions.

options.label: Tell her you understand the burden she carries
options.result: Positive choice (used by the witcher and empress endings).

options.label: Tell her she doesn't have to be good at everything
options.result: Negative choice (counts toward Ciri's death).

best_outcome.pick: Say you understand the burden she carries
best_outcome.why: It is the positive answer for both surviving endings.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Ciri's Fate

decisions.name: Blood on the Battlefield: the emperor
decisions.situation: Later in the same quest you decide whether to take Ciri to the emperor. Emhyr then offers to pay you 2000 crowns.

options.label: Don't go to the emperor; go to Velen instead
options.result: Required for the witcher ending (you are taken to the emperor from there anyway).

options.label: Go to the emperor and refuse his reward
options.result: Used for the empress ending. You are not left empty-handed: you get a new horse instead of the money.

options.label: Go to the emperor and take the 2000 crowns
options.result: Negative choice (counts toward Ciri's death).

best_rewards.why: It is the only option that pays money, but it counts against Ciri.

best_outcome.pick: Velen (witcher ending) or refuse the reward (empress ending)
best_outcome.why: Only taking the money counts against Ciri.

decisions.note: Rewards and Ciri's outcome point opposite ways here. This is the one mandatory choice for the witcher ending.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Ciri's Fate; gamepressure.com: main quest walkthroughs

decisions.name: Final Preparations: the Lodge of Sorceresses
decisions.situation: Ciri has to meet the Lodge of Sorceresses.

options.label: Convince Ciri to go alone
options.result: Positive choice.

options.label: Go with Ciri
options.result: Negative choice (counts toward Ciri's death).

best_outcome.why: Positive choice for both surviving endings.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Ciri's Fate

decisions.name: The Child of the Elder Blood: Ciri's anger
decisions.situation: Ciri starts to get angry.

options.label: Let her unload her aggression
options.result: Positive choice.

options.label: Tell her to calm down
options.result: Negative choice (counts toward Ciri's death).

best_outcome.why: Positive choice for both surviving endings.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Ciri's Fate

decisions.name: The Child of the Elder Blood: Skjall's grave
decisions.situation: You are asked to visit Skjall's grave with Ciri. Missable: only offered during this quest.

options.label: Agree to visit Skjall's grave with Ciri
options.result: Positive choice.

options.label: Say time is of the essence
options.result: Negative choice (counts toward Ciri's death).

best_outcome.pick: Go to Skjall's grave with Ciri
best_outcome.why: Positive choice for both surviving endings.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Ciri's Fate; game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Radovid, Dijkstra and the North
decisions.situation: Redania's Most Wanted starts a storyline about killing King Radovid that ends in Reason of State.

options.label: Ignore Radovid's storyline
options.result: Radovid stays king.

options.label: Kill Radovid, then stay neutral and let Dijkstra kill Roche
options.result: Dijkstra becomes the ruler.

options.label: Kill Radovid, then ally with Vernon Roche against Dijkstra
options.result: Nilfgaard rules the North and the truce with Nilfgaard is secured. Needed for Ciri's empress ending.

decisions.note: The game does not mark these as good or bad. Allying with Roche is the one that helps Ciri's empress ending.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Fate of the World; game-checklists.com

decisions.name: King's Gambit: who rules Skellige
decisions.situation: Do Possession and The Lord of Undvik first, then choose whom to help. These quests fail when you start The Isle of Mists.

options.label: Help Cerys
options.result: Skellige stays neutral. You expose Birna Bran's conspiracy.

options.label: Help Hjalmar
options.result: The islands join forces against Nilfgaard. You hunt down the Vildkaarls.

options.label: Ignore King's Gambit (Bran)
options.result: The rules change and a civil war starts.

best_moral.why: Keeps the islands neutral and out of the war. Ignoring the quest leads to civil war.

decisions.note: No reward difference is stated in the sources I could read.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Fate of the World; game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Triss or Yennefer
decisions.situation: Geralt can romance one of them. Both give a positive ending.

options.label: Romance Triss
options.result: In Now or Never, pick the dialogue option asking her to stay. Lost if you start it after The Isle of Mists.

options.label: Romance Yennefer
options.result: In The Last Wish, pick the affectionate response after the djinn encounter. The quest fails when you start Ugly Baby.

options.label: Try to romance both
options.result: Geralt ends up alone. The 'It Takes Three to Tango' scene is a humiliating revenge.

best_outcome.why: Both are positive endings. Romancing both is the only bad result.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Triss and Yennefer; gamepressure.com: Fate of the World; allthings.how

decisions.name: A Favor for a Friend: dinner with Keira
decisions.situation: After the quest you can agree to a dinner with Keira and sleep with her.

options.label: Sleep with Keira
options.result: Your relations with Triss and Yennefer get worse.

options.label: Decline
options.result: No effect on Triss or Yennefer.

best_outcome.pick: Decline if you want Triss or Yennefer
best_outcome.why: Sleeping with Keira worsens relations with both.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Keira Metz

decisions.name: For the Advancement of Learning: Keira's fate
decisions.situation: On Fyke Isle you meet Keira at the tower and choose how the conversation ends. Choosing carefully matters because you can lose her as an ally.

options.label: Don't let her take the notes (first dialogue option)
options.result: A duel with Keira. When you kill her, Geralt destroys the notes.

options.label: Convince her to change her mind (second dialogue option)
options.result: You persuade her the plan is too risky. Instead of going to Radovid she moves to Kaer Morhen, and she is guaranteed to take part in the battle there.

options.label: Let her take the notes (third option, the end-conversation icon)
options.result: She teleports to King Radovid without a fight. She later dies, and this unlocks the often-missed quest A Final Kindness.

best_moral.pick: Convince her to change her mind
best_moral.why: Keeps her alive.

best_outcome.pick: Convince her to change her mind
best_outcome.why: Recommended: it guarantees her help in the Battle of Kaer Morhen (needed for an achievement).

decisions.source: game-checklists.com; allthings.how; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs; gamepressure.com: Keira Metz

decisions.name: The Nithing
decisions.situation: A deadly curse was placed on Lothar's son and traces back to the herbalist Jonna. You are asked to redirect it onto her.

options.label: Turn the curse back on her
options.result: You receive 60 crowns, but she disappears and you can no longer trade with her.

options.label: Spare Jonna
options.result: The curse is resolved peacefully, but you get no reward.

best_rewards.pick: Turn the curse back on her
best_rewards.why: You get paid (60 crowns).

best_moral.why: Resolves the curse without harming her.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Where the Cat and Wolf Play...
decisions.situation: A fellow witcher of the School of the Cat massacred a village. You help the survivor Millie track him down.

options.label: Spare Gaetan
options.result: Enables the Take What You Want quest.

options.label: End him
options.result: No follow-up quest.

best_rewards.why: Unlocks the extra quest Take What You Want.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: An Unpaid Debt
decisions.situation: Simun asks you to kill Volund to repay a debt.

options.label: Kill Volund
options.result: You honour your debt.

options.label: Defend the innocent man
options.result: You refuse to kill him.

best_moral.why: He is innocent.

decisions.note: This is part of the Madman Lugos questline, which fails if not finished before King's Gambit.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: In Wolf's Clothing
decisions.situation: Morkvarg the werewolf is cursed to endless hunger and rebirth. Einar, who caused the curse, holds the amulet that undoes it.

options.label: Lift the curse, then leave Morkvarg alive
options.result: He sends you to Novigrad: the moneylender Josta pays 85 gold and gives you a sword and a diagram.

options.label: Lift the curse, then kill Morkvarg
options.result: You get 85 gold from the quest giver and nothing more.

options.label: Trick Morkvarg into ending his own torment
options.result: He ends his suffering.

best_rewards.pick: Lift the curse and leave him alive
best_rewards.why: Josta pays 85 gold and gives you a sword and a diagram.

best_moral.pick: Lift the curse and leave him alive
best_moral.why: He is freed from the curse and spared.

decisions.note: To get the amulet you can talk to Einar or fight him and his three level 14 men.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Hard Times
decisions.situation: You carry a letter meant for the blacksmith Yanne about his family.

options.label: Tell Yanne the truth
options.result: He learns what happened to his family.

options.label: Hide it
options.result: He is spared the news.

decisions.note: No reward difference is stated, and neither choice is clearly better.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Brave Fools Die Young
decisions.situation: Two young Skelligers are in trouble at the Grymmdjarr Monument.

options.label: Help Petter ease his pain
options.result: You help the injured Petter.

options.label: Leave them
options.result: They face the consequences of their bravery.

best_moral.why: He is injured and in pain.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Crime and Punishment
decisions.situation: Yorg is chained to a rock and claims he was framed for murder.

options.label: Free Yorg
options.result: Leads to a follow-up in Rogne where his sister confesses she lied, revealing what really happened.

options.label: Leave him
options.result: He stays chained.

decisions.note: No reward difference is stated in the sources I could read.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Possession
decisions.situation: Jarl Udalryk is haunted by a hym feeding on his guilt. Cerys has a plan.

options.label: Go along with Cerys's deception
options.result: A short battle with Uldryk's men (you don't have to kill them). When the baby is put in your hands you must decide quickly and throw it into the oven.

options.label: Deal with it the witcher way
options.result: You fight the hym. If Uldryk panics, use Axii on him. It retreats to the basement at about three quarters health.

decisions.note: Part of the Coronation quests that fail when you start The Isle of Mists.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Flesh for Sale
decisions.situation: Pirates run a slave operation in Trottheim on Faroe Isle.

options.label: Refuse to follow the guard
options.result: You fight about 15 pirates (level 11-12), take the keys from their leader, free the slaves and search the leader's house, where there are many valuable items.

options.label: Play along and keep saying you're from Nilfgaard
options.result: You pay 500 crowns for the "merchandise" or use level 3 Delusion. The leader gives you the key and you free the slaves for a diagram and a runestone.

best_rewards.why: You keep your 500 crowns and can loot the leader's house.

decisions.note: Becomes unavailable once Following the Thread progresses.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Open Sesame: The Safecracker
decisions.situation: You need somebody to open a safe.

options.label: Recruit Casimir in Alness
options.result: The safe door is blown up.

options.label: Recruit Quinto near Oxenfurt
options.result: The quiet option.

decisions.note: To use Casimir safely, go after him right away: he becomes unavailable soon.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Scenes From a Marriage: the rose
decisions.situation: After helping Iris close her painful memories you must decide about the rose.

options.label: Take the rose she offers
options.result: She dies and the magic animals are freed.

options.label: Let her keep it
options.result: She stays suffering, and the cat and dog stay stuck.

best_moral.why: It frees the trapped animals, while leaving it keeps everyone stuck.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Whatsoever a Man Soweth...: O'Dimm
decisions.situation: At the Temple of Lilvani you choose between the two endings.

options.label: Challenge Gaunter O'Dimm (good ending)
options.result: Needs you to have met Professor Shakeslock in Oxenfurt (follow Shani) first. You solve a riddle in a magical world; the Viper Venomous Silver Sword is the one good pickup there.

options.label: Let O'Dimm take Olgierd's soul (bad ending)
options.result: You can choose from many rewards, like 5000 Groschen or the Bottomless Carafe, an endless Alcohest replacement.

best_rewards.why: You choose from many rewards, like 5000 Groschen or the Bottomless Carafe.

best_moral.why: The page calls it the good ending.

decisions.note: The good ending needs the Shakeslock detour before the temple. The riddle is solved by destroying a mirror with Aard.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Without a Trace
decisions.situation: In Erde you find an elderly couple who were probably involved in the disappearances.

options.label: Spare the couple
options.result: They live.

options.label: Kill them
options.result: They die.

decisions.note: No reward difference is stated in the sources I could read.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: A Midnight Clear: Shani
decisions.situation: After the wedding you can stay in the area and romance Shani. Missable: only during Dead Man's Party.

options.label: Stay and romance Shani
options.result: Starts the Shani romance.

options.label: Leave
options.result: No romance, and the quest is lost.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: The Night of Long Fangs: Syanna or Orianna
decisions.situation: Dettlaff attacks Beauclair. You choose which trail to follow. The paths are mutually exclusive.

options.label: Hunt Syanna
options.result: Syanna's path.

options.label: Pursue Orianna
options.result: Offers an extra main quest, Blood Simple. After it you can still return to Syanna's path.

decisions.note: The path you pick decides which later quests exist.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Aerondight: the five virtues
decisions.situation: There Can Only Be One unlocks the Aerondight sword once you have shown all five virtues. Several come from choices.

options.label: Compassion: spare the shaelmaar in The Beast of Toussaint
options.result: Counts as Compassion.

options.label: Wisdom: answer "Greenhouse" at the end of The Beast of Toussaint
options.result: Counts as Wisdom.

options.label: Generosity: tip the boy five crowns when you get the letter after Blood Run
options.result: Counts as Generosity.

options.label: Honor: keep Vivienne's secret in The Warble of a Smitten Knight
options.result: Counts as Honor.

options.label: Valor: win the tourney in The Warble of a Smitten Knight
options.result: Counts as Valor.

best_rewards.why: Unlocks the Aerondight sword in the lake.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: The Warble of a Smitten Knight: Vivienne's curse
decisions.situation: Missable: only before Capture the Castle. You discover Vivienne's curse.

options.label: Transfer the curse to Guillaume
options.result: Reveals her secret.

options.label: Use an oriole egg
options.result: Keeps her secret. It cures her but limits her remaining life to seven years.

best_rewards.why: Keeping her secret is the Honor virtue needed for the Aerondight sword.

decisions.note: Neither option is clearly the moral one: the egg shortens her life, the transfer exposes her.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Till Death Do You Part
decisions.situation: A ghostly married couple argue at the Temple Cemetery. To stop it you must move one of their urns.

options.label: Side with the wife
options.result: Rewards you with Gwent cards.

options.label: Side with the husband
options.result: Earns you the sword Forged in Fire.

best_rewards.why: A sword is usually worth more than cards.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Goodness, Gracious, Great Balls of Granite!
decisions.situation: An old man is using the stolen "crown jewels" to improve his bedroom performance.

options.label: Return the stones
options.result: You get a Reginald figurine.

options.label: Let the man keep them
options.result: No figurine.

best_rewards.why: You get a Reginald figurine.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Father Knows Worst
decisions.situation: Hugo says his brothers want him dead to control the family business.

options.label: Reconcile the brothers
options.result: Peaceful ending.

options.label: Fight
options.result: Violent ending.

best_moral.why: Avoids a fight.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Feet as Cold as Ice
decisions.situation: Jacquette's fiance François is trying to slay a monster in a cave.

options.label: Help him fight
options.result: He survives.

options.label: Let him go alone
options.result: He dies.

best_moral.why: Letting him go alone leads to his death.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Mutual of Beauclair's Wild Kingdom: the basilisk
decisions.situation: You find the silver basilisk and choose to spare or kill it.

options.label: Spare it
options.result: 350 crowns, but hateful posters appear in the city.

options.label: Kill it
options.result: The Guild is happy and pays more.

best_rewards.why: The Guild pays more.

best_moral.why: Spares the creature.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Twisted Firestarter: Napp
decisions.situation: You find the firestarter hiding in a building.

options.label: Release Napp
options.result: Tell Willis you did not find the firestarter.

options.label: Capture Napp (fist fight, or Axii to make him come along)
options.result: He is given to the Nilfgaardians. Willis lowers the prices of his goods and services.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Missing in Action: the deserter
decisions.situation: You find Dune's brother Bastien with a wounded Nilfgaardian deserter, Rhosyn.

options.label: Suggest leaving Rhosyn there
options.result: You leave him in the cabin.

options.label: Escort Rhosyn to Bastien's home
options.result: A thank-you for saving Bastien's life.

decisions.note: Both give the same 25 experience. This quest is lost once Imperial Audience starts.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Precious Cargo: the merchant
decisions.situation: The merchant who wants his lost cargo is the one who ordered the attack on the transport.

options.label: Ignore the attack trails and give him the cargo
options.result: 25 experience and 20 crowns.

options.label: Accuse him of lying and chase him, then hand him to the Nilfgaardians
options.result: 10 experience and 30 crowns.

options.label: Accuse him, then release him
options.result: 10 experience and 50 crowns.

options.label: Accuse him, then let him go for his herbals
options.result: 10 experience, 50 crowns and 5 celandines.

options.label: Kill him during the chase
options.result: Experience, and celandines if you search the body.

decisions.note: It trades experience for crowns: giving him the cargo is the most experience, letting him go the most crowns.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Contract: Devil by the Well: Odolan's payment
decisions.situation: After you lift the haunting, the villager Odolan offers to pay. You can bargain for about 25 crowns more beforehand.

options.label: Take the bargained payment
options.result: You receive the agreed crowns.

options.label: Let him keep his gold
options.result: You receive an amethyst instead.

best_moral.why: He keeps his money and thanks you with an amethyst.

decisions.note: This is the one contract that can fail: finish it before On Thin Ice.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Funeral Pyres: the priest's bribe
decisions.situation: After you burn the bodies, the Priest of the Eternal Fire, who is behind the dead, tries to pay you.

options.label: Accept the payment
options.result: 60 crowns and 45 experience.

options.label: Decline the bribe
options.result: A fight with the priest and a few guards. 45 experience, and 200 crowns on his body.

best_rewards.why: You still get the experience and can loot 200 crowns from the priest.

best_moral.why: You don't take money from the man responsible.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Contract: Missing Brother: Brun's payment
decisions.situation: You tell Brun the bad news about his brother, and he refuses to pay what was agreed.

options.label: Take half the payment
options.result: You accept half of the agreed sum.

options.label: Use the upgraded Axii sign (needs a fully developed Delusion skill)
options.result: He gives you the full payment.

best_rewards.why: You get the full payment.

best_moral.why: He has just lost his brother.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Wild at Heart: Margrit's offer
decisions.situation: Margrit, sister of the missing Hanna, tries to convince you to stop the search.

options.label: Accept her proposition
options.result: 72 experience and 55 crowns. You then tell Niellen you couldn't find his wife; he may pay you 10 crowns, and you get 45 experience.

options.label: Refuse and keep searching
options.result: You find Hanna's mutilated body and follow the werewolf's tracks to the real culprit.

best_rewards.why: 72 experience and 55 crowns up front.

best_moral.why: You uncover the truth instead of leaving a husband in the dark.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Wild at Heart: Margrit's life
decisions.situation: In the fight with the werewolf you learn that it is Niellen. You must decide quickly.

options.label: Save Margrit
options.result: The duel goes on and you kill the werewolf.

options.label: Let Niellen kill Margrit
options.result: Then he asks you to finish him.

best_moral.why: She lives.

decisions.note: You get 45 experience and can take Niellen's Key either way.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: A Greedy God: the sylvan
decisions.situation: A sylvan extorts gifts from the local villagers.

options.label: Tell the peasants to bring better gifts (you can also tell them about the crypt)
options.result: The sylvan keeps being fed.

options.label: Kill the sylvan
options.result: You take precious alchemy ingredients from his body and search the cave. The peasants are unhappy.

options.label: Threaten him with death
options.result: He agrees to take lesser gifts and the peasants are very happy. You can still tell them about the crypt.

best_rewards.why: Precious alchemy ingredients and the cave's loot.

best_outcome.why: The source says the peasants are very happy.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Lynch Mob: the prisoner
decisions.situation: Peasants have captured a Nilfgaardian soldier and want to hang him.

options.label: Stop them
options.result: A fight against four level 7 enemies. The prisoner then gives you some gold.

options.label: Let them finish
options.result: He is hanged.

best_rewards.why: You get some gold from the prisoner.

decisions.note: The guide says the right choice here is mostly a matter of your own morality.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Hazardous Goods: the plagued bodies
decisions.situation: A man is transporting plague corpses for money.

options.label: Burn the corpses with Igni
options.result: 20 experience.

options.label: Leave him alone
options.result: No reward.

best_rewards.why: 20 experience, and nothing if you walk away.

best_moral.why: Stops the plague from spreading.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Witcher Wannabe: the impostor
decisions.situation: You find a man falsely posing as a witcher, and the peasants arrive.

options.label: Tell the peasants immediately
options.result: They deal with him.

options.label: Make him work in the village
options.result: He stays and works.

options.label: Have him exiled
options.result: He is sent away.

decisions.note: 85 experience whichever you choose.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Blood Ties: the soldier's mother
decisions.situation: A Nilfgaardian noblewoman searches for her son, who deserted and was hanged.

options.label: Tell her he died in combat
options.result: A kinder lie.

options.label: Admit that he deserted
options.result: The truth.

decisions.note: 50 gold either way. What you told Quartermaster Eggebracht in the contract Patrol Gone Missing also affects this quest.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Contract: Swamp Thing: Leslaw's payment
decisions.situation: Leslaw does not have the money you agreed on.

options.label: Make him pay now
options.result: Slightly less than promised.

options.label: Come back in a week
options.result: Twice the bargained sum, up to 560 crowns. Meditating speeds up the wait.

best_rewards.why: You get twice the money.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Contract: An Elusive Thief: the doppler
decisions.situation: After you take down two thirds of the doppler's health he surrenders, and you decide his fate.

options.label: Make him fight
options.result: His health refills and you must defeat him. You get the doppler trophy (+5% gold found), good shoes and the money reward (up to 300 crowns).

options.label: Free him
options.result: You get 215 crowns, half of the bargained reward and a diagram for a unique goblin sword.

best_rewards.why: The guide calls it the better decision: 215 crowns, half the reward and the goblin sword diagram.

best_moral.why: He is spared.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Contract: Deadly Delights: the succubus
decisions.situation: You face the succubus Salma and can spare her or fight her.

options.label: Fight her
options.result: You get a succubus mutagen, a trophy (+5% gold found) and 186 crowns.

options.label: Spare her
options.result: You get the trophy (a gift), 186 crowns and the valuable sword Maugrim, but not the mutagen.

best_moral.why: She is spared.

decisions.note: The two options trade a mutagen for a sword. The sources do not say which is worth more.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Contract: Woodland Beast: the Scoia'tael
decisions.situation: The attacks on the convoys come from a Scoia'tael commando. An elf aims at you and offers to talk.

options.label: Promise to stay silent and tell the captain about the elves
options.result: You get random crafting materials from the elves, then a travel pass but no money from the captain.

options.label: Promise to stay silent and tell the captain nothing
options.result: The quest ends successfully, with no reward.

options.label: Fight and kill the elves
options.result: Four elves (level 5) and the leader (level 9). Bring their tails as proof for 30 crowns and a travel pass.

best_rewards.why: The only option that pays crowns as well as the pass.

best_moral.pick: Promise silence and tell the captain nothing
best_moral.why: You spare the elves and keep your word, but there is no reward.

decisions.note: The travel pass is used in Thou Shalt Not Pass.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: The Creature from the Oxenfurt Forest: the letter
decisions.situation: At the griffin's nest you find a letter showing the mercenaries took the same contract earlier for a bigger reward.

options.label: Tell Hans about the letter
options.result: You get a bigger price, around 500 crowns.

options.label: Say nothing
options.result: You get the original price.

best_rewards.why: A bigger price, around 500 crowns.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: The Sad Tale of the Grossbart Brothers
decisions.situation: You find the three Grossbart brothers' cave with the man who asked for your help.

options.label: Help him fight
options.result: Three level 26 brothers. He gives you 50 crowns, and the chests hold diagrams for enhanced vampire oil and a bear gear enhancement.

options.label: Resign from the quest
options.result: He goes in alone and dies.

best_rewards.why: 50 crowns and two diagrams.

best_moral.why: Otherwise he dies alone.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: The Tower Outta Nowheres: the brother
decisions.situation: After the tower, a villager asks if you found his brother.

options.label: Tell him his brother died
options.result: The truth.

options.label: Lie that you haven't seen him
options.result: He keeps hoping.

decisions.note: You can also refuse the questgiver's 64 crowns. No reward difference is stated.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: In the Heart of the Wood: the Leshen (Kaer Muire)
decisions.situation: A Leshen is attacking a village. Whom you tell about it is an important decision that shapes the rest of the quest.

options.label: Tell Harald: perform the ancient ritual
options.result: Take 5 hearts from white wolves and sacrifice at the altar. Villagers then come to take Harald: interrupt them (fight four level 20 warriors, no reputation loss) or let him be killed. 60 gold either way.

options.label: Tell Sven: kill the Leshen
options.result: Find the girl Hilde marked by the Leshen, then convince the villagers to kill her or only exile her (no effect on the quest). Destroy three totems and kill the Leshen. The villagers kill Harald afterwards; you can avenge him or walk away. 60 gold.

decisions.note: The sources do not rate either path. Reward is 60 gold either way.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: The Taxman Cometh: the tax inspector's questions
decisions.situation: With more than 35,000 crowns, in Oxenfurt, an inspector asks three questions about how you got your money.

options.label: Answer mostly No
options.result: You get a diploma and the quest ends.

options.label: Answer mostly Yes
options.result: You must pay 1000 crowns of tax at Vivaldi's Bank to finish.

best_rewards.why: You keep your 1000 crowns.

best_moral.why: It is the honest answer.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Paperchase: the bank guards
decisions.situation: After the bureaucracy you find the Cianfanelli Bank is broke.

options.label: Fight the guards
options.result: An immediate 200 crowns.

options.label: Wait one week
options.result: 500 crowns and the silver sword The Reckoner.

best_rewards.why: 500 crowns and a silver sword instead of 200 crowns.

decisions.source: game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Get Junior: Gustaw Roene
decisions.situation: In the fight arena you defeat Gustaw Roene.

options.label: Spare him after winning
options.result: He helps you against the later enemies in the arena.

options.label: Don't spare him
options.result: You fight those enemies without his help.

best_rewards.why: He helps you fight the later enemies (wild dogs, wyvern, endregas, Boris the bear).

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: main quest walkthroughs

decisions.name: Get Junior: Rico
decisions.situation: If you raid the casino aggressively you find the imprisoned spy Rico, who has information on Junior's deal with the Redanians.

options.label: Free Rico
options.result: Starts the side quest Honor Among Thieves. He sends you to the Putrid Grove, where the King of Beggars rewards you with the great sword Eirlithrad and an armor.

options.label: Leave him
options.result: No side quest and no reward.

best_rewards.why: The King of Beggars gives you the sword Eirlithrad and an armor.

best_moral.why: He is a prisoner.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: main quest walkthroughs; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Get Junior: Junior's fate
decisions.situation: In the final confrontation you decide whether Junior lives. The game's ending mentions this plot.

options.label: Kill Junior
options.result: The doppler Dudu takes his place and the criminal group becomes harmless under him.

options.label: Spare Junior
options.result: He survives but is demoted and becomes harmless.

decisions.note: Both options are harmless for the city, and the guide does not rate either.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: main quest walkthroughs; gamepressure.com: Major supporting characters

decisions.name: Novigrad Dreaming: the godling Sara
decisions.situation: A godling named Sara has moved into Corrine Tilly's house.

options.label: Make an agreement with Sara
options.result: You then tell the owner the house is haunted or tell her the truth; it makes no difference. Sara befriends Corrine.

options.label: Chase her away
options.result: Buy Burdock from the herbalist and burn it in the stove with Igni. The owner promises you part of the profit from selling the house. Sara goes to the swamps and befriends someone else.

best_rewards.why: The owner promises you some of the profit from selling the house.

best_moral.why: Sara and Corrine become friends.

decisions.note: The guide calls both outcomes positive.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: main quest walkthroughs; gamepressure.com: Major supporting characters

decisions.name: Now or Never: the mages of Novigrad
decisions.situation: Triss asks you to help the mages escape Novigrad. You decide the fate of the mages by completing or ignoring the quest.

options.label: Complete the quest (help Triss and the mages escape)
options.result: The mages survive, but hostility toward non-humans grows.

options.label: Ignore the quest
options.result: The mages are captured and killed in the slaughter in Novigrad.

best_moral.why: The mages survive.

decisions.note: The guide says both endings are bad. The quest also has the Triss romance choices (see the Triss entry) and must be started before The Isle of Mists.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: main quest walkthroughs; gamepressure.com: Major supporting characters

decisions.name: Count Reuven's Treasure: the spy
decisions.situation: Triss tortures Menge's man for information and you learn Dandelion is on the temple island.

options.label: Kill the spy
options.result: He dies.

options.label: Wipe his memory
options.result: He lives and forgets.

best_moral.why: He is spared.

decisions.note: Only comes up if you attack Menge's men (Option B).
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: main quest walkthroughs

decisions.name: Broken Flowers: Vespula
decisions.situation: You meet Vespula, who is being held, and have three ways to deal with her captors.

options.label: Defeat them
options.result: A fight.

options.label: Lie that the woman is under the King of Beggars' protection
options.result: No fight and no cost.

options.label: Pay 200 crowns for her
options.result: It costs 200 crowns.

best_rewards.pick: Lie about the King of Beggars
best_rewards.why: It costs nothing and avoids the fight.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: main quest walkthroughs

decisions.name: Pyres of Novigrad: the password
decisions.situation: A thief leads you toward a trap or to the Putrid Grove and gives you a password.

options.label: Say the password
options.result: Free, and the beggars' path is easier and quicker.

options.label: Don't give the password and pay 50 crowns
options.result: It costs 50 crowns.

options.label: Don't give the password and use Axii
options.result: You get extra experience.

best_rewards.why: Extra experience and it costs nothing.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: main quest walkthroughs

decisions.name: Practicum in Advanced Alchemy: the succubus
decisions.situation: A succubus took the pimpernel plant you need.

options.label: Kill her
options.result: You obtain her ingredients and mutagens, then follow the path to the cave where the pimpernel is.

options.label: Spare her
options.result: You avoid the fight and are guided to the same cave to take the plant.

best_rewards.why: You get her ingredients and mutagens.

best_moral.why: You get what you need without a fight.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: main quest walkthroughs

decisions.name: Brothers in Arms: who comes to Kaer Morhen
decisions.situation: You recruit allies for the battle with the Wild Hunt. Some need specific choices long before. Recruiting at least seven gives the "Full Crew" trophy.

options.label: Ermion
options.result: Meet her at Kaer Trolde on Skellige after reaching act 2 and ask for help.

options.label: Hjalmar
options.result: Meet him at Kaer Trolde after reaching act 2 and ask for help.

options.label: Keira Metz
options.result: Finish her side quests, and in For the Advancement of Learning convince her to go to Kaer Morhen. Do not attack her and do not let her walk away.

options.label: Letho
options.result: Finish The Fall of the House of Reardon. He cannot be recruited if he died in Witcher 2.

options.label: Triss Merigold
options.result: Finish all her side quests; Now or Never is the most important.

options.label: Vernon Roche
options.result: Finish his side quests; An Eye for an Eye is the most important. After act 2 meet him at the Temerian partisan hideout and ask.

options.label: Ves
options.result: She joins once you have recruited Vernon Roche.

options.label: Zoltan Chivay
options.result: Finish his side quests; An Eye for an Eye is the most important. After act 2 meet him at Rosemary and Thyme and ask.

best_rewards.why: That unlocks the Full Crew trophy.

decisions.note: In some cases a wrong decision makes an ally impossible to get. The guide specifically warns about Keira.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: main quest walkthroughs; game-checklists.com

decisions.name: Yennefer: the small romance choices
decisions.situation: Besides The Last Wish, Yennefer has several smaller moments where you choose how close to get.

options.label: At the Skellige wake: refuse a drink
options.result: Gains Yennefer's approval.

options.label: At the wake: protect her dignity by brawling with an old man
options.result: You then get pushed to drink again.

options.label: After the grotto battle: pick "I want to kiss you"
options.result: Unlocks a love scene. Pick the option that clearly says you want to get close.

options.label: Convince her the wake can wait while she fixes her dress
options.result: A love scene on a unicorn, then you return to the wake.

options.label: At the Kaer Morhen feast: go to her chamber
options.result: The two have some fun upstairs. If you refuse you return to your colleagues.

decisions.note: These do not decide Triss or Yennefer by themselves (see the Triss or Yennefer entry).
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: main quest walkthroughs; gamepressure.com: Triss and Yennefer

decisions.name: Triss: the romance choices
decisions.situation: Triss's romance builds over two quests.

options.label: At the mask ball (A Matter of Life and Death): kiss her in the garden
options.result: A step toward the romance. You only have a few seconds to react.

options.label: At the ball: beat up the guest who harasses her, or just walk away
options.result: You can do either when he harasses Triss.

options.label: At the harbor after the Katakan (Now or Never): tell her you love her
options.result: Your last chance to start the relationship. It affects the ending.

options.label: Hesitate (the middle option)
options.result: It counts as refusing.

best_outcome.pick: Kiss her at the ball and say you love her at the harbor
best_outcome.why: These are the steps that start the Triss romance, if you choose Triss.

decisions.note: Do not also tell Yennefer you love her: romancing both ends with neither. Both quests must be done before The Isle of Mists.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: main quest walkthroughs; gamepressure.com: Triss and Yennefer; allthings.how

decisions.name: Forefathers' Eve: the ritual
decisions.situation: Witch Hunters arrive during the Pellar's ritual on Fyke Isle.

options.label: Say you won't take part and let the hunters stop the ritual
options.result: The quest ends there.

options.label: Help the Pellar
options.result: You fight the newcomers, then wraiths, and are then tasked with finding the corpse of the Pellar's father on the swamps.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Redania's Most Wanted: the crystal
decisions.situation: You bring a crystal back to King Radovid, and Witch Hunters wait at the exit.

options.label: Give Radovid the crystal
options.result: He pays you 135 crowns.

options.label: Refuse, or lie that you found nothing
options.result: The Witch Hunters attack you, and you get no payment.

best_rewards.why: He pays you 135 crowns.

decisions.note: Redania's Most Wanted is one of the three quests needed for Reason of State.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Carnal Sins: Eustace
decisions.situation: To make the corpse collector Eustace talk:

options.label: Pay him 200 crowns
options.result: It costs 200 crowns.

options.label: Use the Axii sign
options.result: He talks for free.

best_rewards.why: It saves 200 crowns.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Carnal Sins: the client at the brothel
decisions.situation: You find the girl and one of the clients in the top room.

options.label: Kill him
options.result: You receive diagrams.

options.label: Use the Axii sign on him
options.result: No diagrams.

options.label: Ignore the situation
options.result: No diagrams.

best_rewards.why: You receive diagrams.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Following the Thread: the elf in the inn
decisions.situation: You talk to an elf in the inn, with Lambert nearby.

options.label: Say you don't care
options.result: You must kill her and her four companions (level 11).

options.label: Say not to kill her
options.result: You walk away in peace.

best_moral.why: Nobody dies.

decisions.note: This quest is lost when you start Ugly Baby.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Defender of the Faith: the vandals
decisions.situation: At the last shrine you meet the vandals who destroyed it.

options.label: Defeat them
options.result: You can loot their bodies and finish the quest.

options.label: Walk away without interfering
options.result: You fail the quest.

best_rewards.why: It is the only way to finish the quest, and you can loot the bodies.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Missable Gwent card: the Bloody Baron (Sigismund Dijkstra)
decisions.situation: You can win the Sigismund Dijkstra card (Northern Realms) by beating the Baron at Gwent at Crow's Perch, part of Gwent: Velen Players.

options.label: Play the Baron before Family Matters ends
options.result: You win the Sigismund Dijkstra card.

options.label: Wait until after Family Matters
options.result: He leaves Crow's Perch, so you can't win the card from him.

best_rewards.pick: Play the Baron before Family Matters ends
best_rewards.why: After that he leaves Crow's Perch and the card is lost.

decisions.note: The Gwent checklist says 20 base-game cards can be missed; everything else stays available, even after the story ends.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com: Gwent cards checklist (Missable Gwent Cards)

decisions.name: Missable Gwent cards: before Reason of State
decisions.situation: Three people you can beat at Gwent may die or become unavailable depending on your choices in Reason of State.

options.label: Dijkstra: beat him in his bathhouse office in Novigrad
options.result: You win the Esterad Thyssen card (Northern Realms), part of Gwent: Big City Players. His Francesca Findabair: The Beautiful reward for that chain also needs him alive.

options.label: Thaler: beat him just after saving him in the Reason of State preparation quest
options.result: You win the Geralt of Rivia card (Neutral), part of Gwent: Playing Thaler or Gwent: Old Pals.

options.label: Vernon Roche: beat him at the Temerian partisan hideout
options.result: You win the Saesenthessis card (Scoia'tael), part of Gwent: Old Pals.

best_rewards.pick: Play all three before Reason of State
best_rewards.why: Depending on your choices there, either Dijkstra or Roche and Thaler die.

decisions.note: The Gwent checklist says 20 base-game cards can be missed; everything else stays available, even after the story ends.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com: Gwent cards checklist (Missable Gwent Cards)

decisions.name: Missable Gwent card: Olivier at the Kingfisher
decisions.situation: Olivier, the innkeeper of the Kingfisher in Novigrad, has the Tibor Eggebracht card (Nilfgaard), part of Gwent: Playing Innkeeps.

options.label: Beat Olivier before you start Now or Never
options.result: You win the Tibor Eggebracht card.

options.label: Start Now or Never first
options.result: The card is missed.

best_rewards.pick: Beat Olivier before starting Now or Never
best_rewards.why: The checklist lists it among the missable cards.

decisions.note: The Gwent checklist says 20 base-game cards can be missed; everything else stays available, even after the story ends.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com: Gwent cards checklist (Missable Gwent Cards)

decisions.name: Missable Gwent cards: the Vegelbud party tournament
decisions.situation: At the Vegelbud Residence mask ball, in A Matter of Life and Death, there is a Gwent tournament in the courtyard (three players).

options.label: Win the tournament
options.result: You get Dandelion (Neutral), Milva (Scoia'tael) and Vampire: Bruxa (Scoia'tael).

options.label: Skip it or lose
options.result: You only get one shot, so those three cards are missed.

best_rewards.why: It is the only chance for Dandelion, Milva and Vampire: Bruxa.

decisions.note: The Gwent checklist says 20 base-game cards can be missed; everything else stays available, even after the story ends.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com: Gwent cards checklist (Missable Gwent Cards)

decisions.name: Missable Gwent cards: the High Stakes tournament
decisions.situation: Gwent: High Stakes is a tournament at the Passiflora in Novigrad. Entry is 1,000 crowns, so save first.

options.label: Beat Bernard Tulle
options.result: You win Foltest: The Steel-Forged.

options.label: Beat Sasha
options.result: You win Emhyr var Emreis: The Relentless.

options.label: Beat Finneas
options.result: You win Francesca Findabair: Queen of Dol Blathanna.

options.label: Beat Count Tybalt
options.result: You win Eredin: Bringer of Death.

best_rewards.why: Each match pays one leader card. Lose a match and that card is gone.

decisions.note: Don't walk out of the Passiflora in the middle of the tournament. The Gwent checklist says 20 base-game cards can be missed; everything else stays available, even after the story ends.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com: Gwent cards checklist (Missable Gwent Cards); allthings.how

decisions.name: Missable Gwent cards: A Dangerous Game
decisions.situation: Zoltan asks you to help complete his Gwent collection by retrieving several cards.

options.label: Do the quest
options.result: You get John Natalis (Northern Realms) and Isengrim Faoiltiarna, which only come from this quest, and Fringilla Vigo (Nilfgaard).

options.label: Skip it
options.result: John Natalis and Isengrim are missed. Fringilla Vigo can still drop from the prison warden you defeat in The Great Escape.

best_rewards.why: John Natalis and Isengrim Faoiltiarna come from nowhere else.

decisions.note: Also pick up the green statuette here, or you cannot finish The Soldier Statuette later. The Gwent checklist says 20 base-game cards can be missed; everything else stays available, even after the story ends.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com: Gwent cards checklist (Missable Gwent Cards); allthings.how

decisions.name: Missable Gwent card: Iorveth (Shock Therapy)
decisions.situation: Iorveth (Scoia'tael) is the reward for the Shock Therapy side quest on Skellige, where Geralt scares a druid into breaking his vow of silence.

options.label: Finish Shock Therapy
options.result: You get the Iorveth card.

options.label: Skip it
options.result: The card is missed.

best_rewards.why: The checklist lists the card among the missable ones.

decisions.note: The checklist does not say exactly when the quest is lost, so do it before moving on from Skellige. The Gwent checklist says 20 base-game cards can be missed; everything else stays available, even after the story ends.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com: Gwent cards checklist (Missable Gwent Cards)

decisions.name: Missable Gwent cards: the caged merchant
decisions.situation: A merchant is caged near Boatmakers' Hut in Velen.

options.label: Free the merchant
options.result: He moves to Claywich and is the only one selling Puttkammer, Sweers, Black Infantry Archer #2 and Etolian Auxiliary Archers #2 (all Nilfgaard).

options.label: Leave him
options.result: Those four cards can't be bought.

best_rewards.why: He is the only seller of four Nilfgaard cards.

best_moral.why: He is caged.

decisions.note: The Gwent checklist says 20 base-game cards can be missed; everything else stays available, even after the story ends.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com: Gwent cards checklist (Missable Gwent Cards)

decisions.name: Gwent cards that look missable but aren't
decisions.situation: A few cards look like they can be lost, but the checklist says they can't.

options.label: Foltest: The Siegemaster (Vizima)
options.result: Beat the Nilfgaardian Nobleman. You return to Vizima before the Battle of Kaer Morhen, so you can still do it.

options.label: Zoltan Chivay
options.result: Normally from Aldert Geert in the White Orchard inn. If he dies, loot the card from his body under the Hanged Man's Tree.

options.label: Draug
options.result: Beat Crach an Craite in Gwent: Skellige Style. If you haven't played him before the battle in On Thin Ice, he gives you the card automatically.

options.label: Vampire: Katakan
options.result: From beating Madman Lugos in Gwent: Skellige Style, or, if he dies during The Sunstone, loot it from his house at Kaer Muire.

decisions.note: No need to rush these. The Gwent checklist says 20 base-game cards can be missed; everything else stays available, even after the story ends.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com: Gwent cards checklist (Missable Gwent Cards)

decisions.name: Hearts of Stone: Gwent players you meet only once
decisions.situation: In Hearts of Stone there are no random Gwent players: every opponent is tied to a quest, and in most cases you meet them only once.

options.label: Robert Hilbert
options.result: Beat him during Open Sesame! at the Borsodi auction house.

options.label: Shani
options.result: Beat her during the main story after visiting the professor in Whatsoever a Man Soweth...

options.label: Olgierd von Everec
options.result: Beat him at Garin Estate after progressing the main story.

best_rewards.pick: Play whenever you get the chance
best_rewards.why: The guide says you usually meet each player only once, in one quest.

decisions.note: The checklist does not flag the Hearts of Stone cards as missable; this follows gamepressure's advice to play whenever you can.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: Gwent (Hearts of Stone); game-checklists.com: DLC Gwent cards checklist

decisions.name: Fake Papers: the border pass
decisions.situation: A shady merchant near the Pontar river sells a transit pass. You can get it three ways.

options.label: Buy it for 100 crowns
options.result: The full price.

options.label: Use the developed Axii sign on him
options.result: He sells you the pass for 50 crowns, and you get 40 experience.

options.label: Help his brother-in-law in Bitter Harvest
options.result: The merchant lowers the price by 50 crowns.

best_rewards.why: The pass costs 50 crowns instead of 100, and you get 40 experience.

decisions.note: Bitter Harvest is risky for this: if the brother-in-law dies in the ghoul fight the merchant gets angry and won't sell even at full price.
decisions.source: game-checklists.com; gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Thou Shalt Not Pass: crossing the border
decisions.situation: Redanian troops block the border outposts of Velen and nobody without a proper document gets through.

options.label: Bribe the guard (10 crowns) to learn how to get a pass
options.result: You learn it, but this is not mandatory.

options.label: Use Axii on the guard to learn how to get a pass
options.result: 25 experience. Also not mandatory.

options.label: Get a pass and show it to the guard
options.result: From Fake Papers, from the Baron's Letter of Safe Conduct in Family Matters, or from the Woodland Beast contract. The guard lets you through and you get 75 experience.

options.label: Skip the guard and bypass the barricade
options.result: For example by taking a boat to the other side.

best_rewards.pick: Get a pass and show it to the guard
best_rewards.why: 75 experience, against 25 for the Axii trick.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Love's Cruel Snares: the reward
decisions.situation: A woman's fiance has been killed by wild dogs and she offers you a reward.

options.label: Take the reward
options.result: 40 crowns and less experience.

options.label: Refuse the reward
options.result: More experience.

best_moral.why: She has just lost her fiance, and you get more experience.

decisions.note: It trades 40 crowns for more experience.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Worthy of Trust: the crook
decisions.situation: A Skelligian merchant asked you for a 150-crown loan. You meet him again and find out he lied.

options.label: Kill him
options.result: You fight him and recover your 150 crowns, plus 20 crowns for completing the quest.

options.label: Give him to the jarl
options.result: You fight him either way.

options.label: Spare him
options.result: The quest is not added to the journal and you only get 20 crowns.

best_rewards.why: You get your 150 crowns back, plus 20.

decisions.note: He is a level 12 non-fighter and no one comes to his aid.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Little Red: the werewolf girl
decisions.situation: A group of bandits led by a werewolf girl asks the villagers to hand over one of their own.

options.label: Agree to give them a villager
options.result: No fight, the villagers say nothing, and you receive 20 crowns.

options.label: Fight them
options.result: You can collect werewolf alchemy ingredients and the villagers pay you 10 crowns.

best_moral.why: You don't hand a villager over.

decisions.note: The sources do not say which option pays better: crowns versus ingredients.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Empty Coop: the hen thieves
decisions.situation: Grandma Yanina's hens are being stolen, and the trail leads to a group of kids.

options.label: Tell Yanina about the thieves
options.result: You get 20 crowns.

options.label: Convince her to take the kids in
options.result: You get nothing.

best_rewards.why: 20 crowns.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: The Volunteer: the Rock Ogre
decisions.situation: A friendly Rock Ogre sings Redanian army songs.

options.label: Attack the ogre
options.result: He is level 13 and not hard. You can take precious alchemy ingredients from his body.

options.label: Bring him the paint, then help him paint the eagle
options.result: The result is not astonishing, but the ogre is happy.

options.label: Bring him the paint, then convince him to paint it himself
options.result: The result is much better.

best_moral.why: He is friendly.

best_outcome.pick: Convince him to paint it himself
best_outcome.why: The source says the result is much better.

decisions.note: If you befriend him the reward is the same either way: some gold, a few diagrams and many kinds of leather.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Contract: Here Comes the Groom: Britt's payment
decisions.situation: After killing the melusine, you agree to tell Britt what happened to her fiance.

options.label: Take the gold from her
options.result: You collect extra payment.

options.label: Refuse any additional payment
options.result: You take only what Kevan agreed.

best_rewards.why: It is extra money.

best_moral.why: She has just lost her fiance.

decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Contract: The Phantom of Eldberg: Mikkjaal
decisions.situation: After the penitent is beaten, you decide Mikkjaal's fate.

options.label: Exile him
options.result: He is sent away.

options.label: Let him stay
options.result: He remains.

decisions.note: The sources do not rate either choice, and the reward is not described as different.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Fists of Fury: Novigrad: the powder
decisions.situation: In the second illegal fight, the organizer asks you to take a powder and lose on purpose.

options.label: Agree to take the powder
options.result: You get more money, but your win statistics get worse. You can still beat the challenger afterwards.

options.label: Beat him fairly
options.result: Better win statistics.

best_rewards.why: You get more money.

best_outcome.why: The guide says your win statistics are better.

decisions.note: Rewards and the fight record point opposite ways. The maximum bet in this fight is 80 crowns.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Out on Your Arse!: the Skelligian guests
decisions.situation: A courtesan asks you to get rid of the Skelligians from inside the inn. You can do it three ways.

options.label: Fist fight the group leader
options.result: A duel.

options.label: Fight the whole group (three people)
options.result: A fight.

options.label: Use Axii
options.result: You get additional experience.

best_rewards.why: It is the only option that gives additional experience.

decisions.note: You get 15 crowns from the girl whichever you choose, even if you refuse taking the reward.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: Of Swords and Dumplings: Sukrus and the honey
decisions.situation: Helping the elf get his dumpling business back, you are given two jobs.

options.label: Convince Sukrus's brother-in-law to pay (Axii)
options.result: You solve it with a sign and no fight.

options.label: Destroy three honey barrels
options.result: The crew attacks you unless you are fast enough.

options.label: At the warehouse, use Axii on the guarding dwarf
options.result: Free.

options.label: At the warehouse, bribe the dwarf with 200 crowns
options.result: It costs 200 crowns.

best_rewards.why: No fight with the crew and no 200 crowns to pay.

decisions.note: You fight a bandit group in the warehouse whatever you say. Hattori then becomes available as a blacksmith.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: side quest and contract walkthroughs

decisions.name: The Play's the Thing: the preparations
decisions.situation: To get your play seen, you need advertising and security.

options.label: Puffins' bandits: attack them (you must kill only one, level 11)
options.result: A fight.

options.label: Puffins' bandits: bribe them with 50 crowns
options.result: It costs 50 crowns.

options.label: Puffins' bandits: use Axii
options.result: Free.

options.label: Docks security: pay 70 crowns upfront
options.result: It costs 70 crowns.

options.label: Docks security: fight two enemies at once
options.result: If you win they help for free; if you lose you pay twice.

best_rewards.pick: Use Axii on the bandits and win the fight at the docks
best_rewards.why: Both are free.

decisions.note: The play itself pays about 100-150 crowns and how you cast it does not matter much.
decisions.source: gamepressure.com: main quest walkthroughs
